newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-SPARTAK BEAT ROTOR TO MAINTAIN TOP SPOT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPARTAK BEAT ROTOR TO MAINTAIN TOP SPOT.

text.p: Maxim Buznikin scored the first hat-trick of his career to allow defending champions Spartak Moscow to beat Rotor Volgograd 3-2 and retain their league lead exactly halfway through the Russian season on Wednesday.
Rotor had gone 2-1 up early in the second half after Alexander Zernov scored his second goal of the night.
It was only the fourth time in 11 league meetings since 1992 that Spartak had beaten the Volgograd side.
Dynamo Moscow stayed on equal points with Spartak by beating lowly KamAZ 3-1 in Naberezhniye Chelny.
Another Moscow side, CSKA, moved out of the relegation zone with a 1-0 victory over bottom-of-the-table Fakel Voronezh.
